metrics.description: This metric shows the total number of dedicated cores in each bucket account. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: CORES = data("CoreCount", filter=filter("resource_type", "Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts") and filter("primary_aggregation_type", "true"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="zero", rollup="latest").mean(by=["azure_resource_name"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the total number of pool events in each bucket account. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template:
CREATING = data("PoolCreateEvent", filter=filter("resource_type", "Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts") and filter("primary_aggregation_type", "true"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="zero", rollup="sum").sum(by=["azure_resource_name"])
RESIZING = data("PoolResizeCompleteEvent", filter=filter("resource_type", "Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts") and filter("primary_aggregation_type", "true"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="zero", rollup="sum").sum(by=["azure_resource_name"])
NODE_LEAVING = data("LeavingPoolNodeCount", filter=filter("resource_type", "Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts") and filter("primary_aggregation_type", "true"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="zero", rollup="sum").sum(by=["azure_resource_name"])
DELETING = data("PoolDeleteCompleteEvent", filter=filter("resource_type", "Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts") and filter("primary_aggregation_type", "true"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="zero", rollup="sum").sum(by=["azure_resource_name"])
POOL_EVENTS = (CREATING + RESIZING + NODE_LEAVING + DELETING).sum(by=["azure_resource_name"])
